item.title: Session #10: Celebrating Tap 1.5
item.description: Celebrating the release of 7III Tap 1.5, the best Ableton Live controller for iPad.
item.content:encoded:
Sorry it took me so long to get episode 10 out, I have been very busy finishing some things for Tap. Which. Is. Now 100% the best Ableton Live controller out there, so good, so really good now!! Try Tap for free!
I still found some bugs in Tap I need to fix during this live set. I also had some crazy audio glitches where I had to stop everything and restart the audio in Ableton Live. I need to find out why it sometimes starts adding those strange artifacts.

Used in this session: iPad with 7III Tap, Ableton Live. All synths are stock Ableton Live instruments. Never had to use the computer (only when I had to restart the audio in Ableton Live), so Tap really works now with the improved encoders/macros and the simple but awesome browser.

Video

If you don’t like audio-only, here’s a YouTube video of the live session: Watch on YouTube
item.itunes:author: Nils Mango
item.itunes:summary: Celebrating the release of 7III Tap 1.5, the best Ableton Live controller for iPad.
